title: Compiled Python bytecode committed to the repo
detail: A .pyc build artifact is added while the .gitignore change only adds .pp-settings.bin; __pycache__/ is not ignored, so it will regenerate and re-dirty.
recommended_fix: Remove the .pyc from the commit and add `__pycache__/` to .gitignore.

title: Unused helpers and dead parameters in derive_a11y_palettes.py
detail: scale_lum and mix are never called; verify's tune parameter is never read; `if classes:` is always true (classes is always non-empty). Dead derivation machinery implies a 'search' that doesn't exist.
recommended_fix: Delete scale_lum, mix, the tune parameter, and the always-true classes guard; docstring's 'search the mode-space' claim should match.

title: palcheck oracle threshold condition tests a first element that never occurs
detail: No constructed pair has canvas as pr[0]; the p.canvas comparison is dead. Worse, pair classification by pr[0] identity is fragile — colors equal by value to a map token silently downgrade the threshold.
recommended_fix: Classify pairs by an explicit tag (signal vs map) carried alongside the colors, not by comparing pr[0] to palette values.

title: drive_parity comment claims caller-owned palette; it is a local
detail: `pal` is a drive_parity local, not caller-owned; build_scenarios uses a different palette instance created in run_input_parity. Two separately-loaded palettes could drift.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment, or pass the run_input_parity palette into drive_parity so both use one instance.

title: S-ownership parity scenario exercises only the mouse device
evidence:
append(&sc, Parity_Scenario{
		name = "input_parity_settings_s_ownership",
...
		mouse = frames(
			evs(inp.Mouse_Press{pos = n0, button = .Left}),
detail: No touch or pad scripts are given, yet check_states asserts `panel_open` false across `len(devs)` runs. Panel-open gating for pad Y / touch chip with a selection is untested.
recommended_fix: Add pad (Y with selection) and touch (chip tap with selection) legs asserting the panel does not open.

title: Every a11y demo issues the same draw command twice
evidence:
at 100ms draw 7 8 standard
at 100ms draw 8 9 wide
...
at 100ms draw 7 8 standard
at 100ms draw 7 8 standard
detail: `draw 7 8 standard` appears twice in each of the five new demos (14 entries for 13 draws). Either intentional clone-from-juice duplication or a copy-paste; identical duplicated line is suspicious.
recommended_fix: Confirm whether the duplicate draw is intended; if the second is spurious, remove it — if juice.dem has it, document the lineage.

title: CI gate labeled 'Core unit tests' now runs five test suites
evidence: "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"
detail: The gate name still says 'Core unit tests' but bundles app, render, audio, harness tests plus a 3x repeat leg; the label misleads on failure triage.
recommended_fix: Rename the gate description (e.g. 'Unit tests (core+app+render+audio+harness, app 3x)') to match its contents.

title: .pp-settings.bin gitignored but settings file lives in HOME
detail: PR body states the settings file is `~/.pp-settings.bin` — outside the repo tree, so the ignore entry only matters if a stray local file existed; harmless but unexplained.
recommended_fix: Either drop the entry or add a comment noting it guards against accidental cwd-relative settings writes.

title: Deutan and protan mode tables are byte-identical
detail: All tokens identical between deutan and protan; only tritan differs. Passing is only shown per-mode against its own simulation — a protan-specific separation issue gets no distinct remap.
recommended_fix: Fine if intentional (oracle enforces each), but document the identity in the JSON comment to preempt 'forgot to differentiate' suspicion.
